# bkui-vue Component Library — LLM Reference Documentation

This document provides a complete API reference for the bkui-vue component library (BlueKing UI Vue3).
It is designed to be consumed by AI agents and LLMs for accurate code generation and assistance.

## Overview

bkui-vue is an enterprise-grade Vue 3 component library developed by Tencent BlueKing.
It provides 59+ UI components for building modern web applications.

- **Package name**: `bkui-vue`
- **Vue compatibility**: Vue 3.2+
- **License**: MIT

## Installation

```bash
npm install bkui-vue
```

### Peer Dependencies

- `vue` ^3.2.0
- `highlight.js` ~11.5.0 (optional, for code highlighting)

## Usage

### Full Import

```typescript
import BkuiVue from 'bkui-vue';
import 'bkui-vue/dist/style.css';

const app = createApp(App);
app.use(BkuiVue);
```

### On-Demand Import

```typescript
import { Button, Select, Table } from 'bkui-vue';
```

### Component Naming Convention

All components are registered with a `Bk` prefix when using global registration.
For example, `Button` becomes `<bk-button>`, `Select` becomes `<bk-select>`, etc.
When importing on-demand, use the PascalCase name directly: `<Button>`, `<Select>`, etc.

## Hooks

bkui-vue exports the following hooks:

- `useGlobalConfig` — Access global configuration
- `provideGlobalConfig` — Provide global configuration
- `useLocale` — Access locale/i18n
- `usePrefix` — Access CSS class name prefix (for theming)
- `defaultRootConfig` — Default root configuration object
- `rootProviderKey` — Injection key for root config

## Component Catalog

### Base

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `<bk-button>` | Basic button component supporting multiple themes (default, primary, success, warning, danger), sizes, loading state, outline and text variants. |
| ConfigProvider | `<bk-config-provider>` | Global configuration provider for setting locale, prefix, and other global settings for all child bkui-vue components. |
| Scrollbar | `<bk-scrollbar>` | Custom scrollbar component providing consistent cross-browser scrollbar styling. |

### Layout

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Container | `<bk-container>` | Grid layout system based on 24-column grid. Includes Row and Col sub-components for responsive layouts. |
| ResizeLayout | `<bk-resize-layout>` | Draggable split-pane layout component. Allows users to resize two adjacent panels by dragging a divider. |

### Navigation

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Affix | `<bk-affix>` | Pin an element to a fixed position on the page when scrolling. Useful for navigation bars, sidebars, or action buttons that should stay visible. |
| Backtop | `<bk-backtop>` | A button that appears when the user scrolls down, allowing them to quickly scroll back to the top of the page. |
| Breadcrumb | `<bk-breadcrumb>` | Navigation breadcrumb trail showing the current page's location within a hierarchical structure. |
| ColorPicker | `<bk-color-picker>` | Color selection component with visual color picker interface. Returns color values in various formats. |
| DatePicker | `<bk-date-picker>` | Date and date-range picker component. Supports date, daterange, datetime, datetimerange, month, and year modes. |
| Divider | `<bk-divider>` | Visual separator line between content sections. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation with optional text label. |
| FixedNavbar | `<bk-fixed-navbar>` | Fixed navigation bar that stays at a fixed position on the page, typically used for quick action shortcuts. |
| Link | `<bk-link>` | Inline text link component with theme support and disabled state. |
| Menu | `<bk-menu>` | Navigation menu component supporting vertical and horizontal modes, sub-menus, groups, and collapse behavior. |
| Navigation | `<bk-navigation>` | Application-level navigation component with sidebar and header layout, typically for backend admin pages. |
| Process | `<bk-process>` | Process/step indicator showing workflow progress. Similar to Steps but with a different visual style. |
| Steps | `<bk-steps>` | Step indicator for multi-step workflows. Shows the current step and progress through a sequence. |
| Tab | `<bk-tab>` | Tab navigation component for switching between different content panels. Supports add/close, drag sorting, and card/border-card styles. |
| TimePicker | `<bk-time-picker>` | Time selection component for picking hours, minutes, and seconds. Supports time range selection. |
| Timeline | `<bk-timeline>` | Vertical timeline component for displaying a sequence of events in chronological order. |

### Form

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cascader | `<bk-cascader>` | Cascading selection component for selecting from a hierarchical data structure (e.g., province/city/district). |
| Checkbox | `<bk-checkbox>` | Checkbox form control for multiple selections. Includes CheckboxGroup for managing a group of checkboxes. |
| Form | `<bk-form>` | Form container component with built-in validation support. Works with FormItem for field-level validation, labels, and layout. |
| Input | `<bk-input>` | Text input component with support for types (text, password, number, textarea, url, email), prefix/suffix icons, clearable, and character count. |
| Radio | `<bk-radio>` | Radio form control for single selection. Includes RadioGroup and RadioButton sub-components. |
| SearchSelect | `<bk-search-select>` | Advanced search input with structured query builder. Supports multiple search conditions with key-value pairs and tags. |
| Select | `<bk-select>` | Dropdown select component with single/multiple selection, search/filter, remote data, virtual scrolling, and custom options. |
| Switcher | `<bk-switcher>` | Toggle switch component for boolean on/off states. |
| TagInput | `<bk-tag-input>` | Input component that manages multiple tags/tokens. Supports autocomplete suggestions, custom tag rendering, and paste handling. |
| Upload | `<bk-upload>` | File upload component supporting drag-and-drop, multiple files, file list display, and custom upload logic. |

### Data

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AnimateNumber | `<bk-animate-number>` | Animate a number from one value to another with a smooth transition effect. Useful for dashboards and statistics displays. |
| Badge | `<bk-badge>` | Display a badge indicator (number or dot) on the top-right corner of another element. Commonly used for notification counts. |
| CodeDiff | `<bk-code-diff>` | Display code differences between two text blocks, similar to a git diff viewer. Supports side-by-side and unified views. |
| Collapse | `<bk-collapse>` | Expandable/collapsible content panels. Multiple panels can be used together with accordion mode support. |
| Dropdown | `<bk-dropdown>` | Dropdown menu component showing a list of actions or options triggered by clicking or hovering on an element. |
| Pagination | `<bk-pagination>` | Pagination control for navigating through paged data. Supports page size selection, quick jumper, and total count display. |
| Progress | `<bk-progress>` | Progress bar component showing completion percentage. Supports linear and circular (dashboard) modes with custom colors. |
| Rate | `<bk-rate>` | Star rating input component. Supports half-star ratings and custom icons. |
| Swiper | `<bk-swiper>` | Image/content carousel component with auto-play, indicators, and navigation arrows. |
| Table | `<bk-table>` | Data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column resizing, virtual scrolling, and custom cell rendering. Supports both column-config and slot-based column definitions. |
| Tag | `<bk-tag>` | Tag/chip component for displaying labels, categories, or status indicators. Supports closable, checkable, and themed variants. |
| Tree | `<bk-tree>` | Tree view component for displaying hierarchical data. Supports expand/collapse, checkbox selection, drag-and-drop, filtering, and lazy loading. |
| VirtualRender | `<bk-virtual-render>` | Virtual scrolling container for efficiently rendering large lists by only rendering visible items in the viewport. |

### Feedback

| Component | Tag Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alert | `<bk-alert>` | Display important alert messages with different severity levels (info, success, warning, danger). Supports closable behavior and custom icons. |
| Card | `<bk-card>` | A container component for displaying grouped content with optional header and footer. Supports collapsible mode. |
| Dialog | `<bk-dialog>` | Modal dialog component for confirmations, forms, and important user interactions. Supports dragging, multi-step, and custom footer. |
| Exception | `<bk-exception>` | Display exception/error pages with predefined types (403, 404, 500, building, empty, login). Used for error states. |
| InfoBox | `<bk-info-box>` | Imperative info/confirmation dialog. Called via function: InfoBox({ title, subTitle, confirmText, onConfirm }). Not a template component. |
| Loading | `<bk-loading>` | Loading spinner overlay for indicating loading state. Can be used as a component or directive (v-bk-loading). |
| Message | `<bk-message>` | Imperative global message notification. Called via function: Message({ theme, message }). Appears at the top of the page. |
| Modal | `<bk-modal>` | Base modal/overlay component used internally by Dialog and Sideslider. Provides the backdrop, animation, and z-index management. |
| Notify | `<bk-notify>` | Imperative notification message. Called via function: Notify({ theme, title, message, position }). Appears at a corner of the page. |
| OverflowTitle | `<bk-overflow-title>` | Automatically show a tooltip when text content overflows its container. Useful for truncated table cells and labels. |
| PopConfirm | `<bk-pop-confirm>` | Popover-based confirm dialog. Shows a small confirmation popup anchored to a trigger element. |
| Popover | `<bk-popover>` | General-purpose popover/tooltip component. Supports click, hover, and manual triggers. Based on @floating-ui for positioning. |
| Popover2 | `<bk-popover2>` | Alternative popover implementation with additional features. Similar API to Popover. |
| Sideslider | `<bk-sideslider>` | Side panel drawer that slides in from the edge of the screen. Useful for detail views, forms, or secondary navigation. |
| Slider | `<bk-slider>` | Slider/range input for selecting a value or range within a defined interval. |
| Transfer | `<bk-transfer>` | Transfer (shuttle) component for moving items between two lists. Supports search filtering and custom rendering. |

---

## Component API Reference

### Button

Basic button component supporting multiple themes (default, primary, success, warning, danger), sizes, loading state, outline and text variants.

- **Tag**: `<bk-button>`
- **Import**: `import { Button } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/button`
- **Category**: Base
- **Sub-components**: ButtonGroup

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-button theme="primary">Primary</bk-button>
  <bk-button theme="success" :loading="true">Loading</bk-button>
  <bk-button theme="danger" outline>Outline</bk-button>
  <bk-button text>Text Button</bk-button>
  <bk-button disabled>Disabled</bk-button>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| theme | theme | - |  |
| hoverTheme | theme | - |  |
| size | ElementType<typeof btnSizes | btnSizes[0] |  |
| title | String | - |  |
| icon | String | - |  |
| iconRight | String | - |  |
| disabled | Boolean | - |  |
| loading | Boolean | - |  |
| loadingMode | `${BkLoadingMode}` | 'default' |  |
| outline | Boolean | - |  |
| text | Boolean | - |  |
| selected | Boolean | - |  |
| nativeType | string | 'button' | circle: PropTypes.bool, |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| click | - |
| mouseover | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Button label content |

---

### ConfigProvider

Global configuration provider for setting locale, prefix, and other global settings for all child bkui-vue components.

- **Tag**: `<bk-config-provider>`
- **Import**: `import { ConfigProvider } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/config-provider`
- **Category**: Base

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-config-provider :locale="locale">
    <App />
  </bk-config-provider>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| locale | Language | - |  |
| prefix | string | 'bk' |  |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Application content |

---

### Scrollbar

Custom scrollbar component providing consistent cross-browser scrollbar styling.

- **Tag**: `<bk-scrollbar>`
- **Import**: `import { Scrollbar } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/scrollbar`
- **Category**: Base

#### Usage

```vue

  <bk-scrollbar style="height: 300px">
    <div>Scrollable content</div>
  </bk-scrollbar>
</template>
```

#### Props

No props.

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Scrollable content |

### Container

Grid layout system based on 24-column grid. Includes Row and Col sub-components for responsive layouts.

- **Tag**: `<bk-container>`
- **Import**: `import { Container } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/container`
- **Category**: Layout
- **Sub-components**: Row, Col

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-container>
    <bk-row>
      <bk-col :span="12">Left</bk-col>
      <bk-col :span="12">Right</bk-col>
    </bk-row>
  </bk-container>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| col | Number | 24 | 栅格数，默认 24 |
| gutter | Number | 20 | 栅格间距，单位 px，左右平分 |
| margin | Number | 20 | 栅格容器的左右外边距 |
| flex | Boolean | false | 控制 row 是否使用 flex 布局 |
| extCls | String | - | 外部设置的 class name |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Row/Col components |

---

### ResizeLayout

Draggable split-pane layout component. Allows users to resize two adjacent panels by dragging a divider.

- **Tag**: `<bk-resize-layout>`
- **Import**: `import { ResizeLayout } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/resize-layout`
- **Category**: Layout

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-resize-layout :initial-divide="300">
    <template #aside>
      Sidebar content
    </template>
    <template #main>
      Main content
    </template>
  </bk-resize-layout>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| placement | placement | - |  |
| min | Number | 3 |  |
| max | Number | Infinity |  |
| triggerWidth | Number | 5 |  |
| triggerOffset | Number | 3 |  |
| initialDivide | oneOfType | - |  |
| immediate | Boolean | - |  |
| disabled | Boolean | - |  |
| collapsible | Boolean | - |  |
| isCollapsed | Boolean | false |  |
| autoMinimize | oneOfType | - |  |
| border | Boolean | true |  |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| before-resize | - |
| resizing | - |
| after-resize | - |
| collapse-change | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| aside | Left/top panel content |
| main | Right/bottom panel content |

---

### Affix

Pin an element to a fixed position on the page when scrolling. Useful for navigation bars, sidebars, or action buttons that should stay visible.

- **Tag**: `<bk-affix>`
- **Import**: `import { Affix } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/affix`
- **Category**: Navigation

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-affix :offset-top="100">
    <bk-button>Affix Button</bk-button>
  </bk-affix>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| offsetTop | Number | 0 |  |
| offsetBottom | Number | - |  |
| target | String | '' |  |
| zIndex | Number | 1000 |  |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| change | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Content to be pinned |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Breadcrumb

Navigation breadcrumb trail showing the current page's location within a hierarchical structure.

- **Tag**: `<bk-breadcrumb>`
- **Import**: `import { Breadcrumb } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/breadcrumb`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Sub-components**: Item, BreadcrumbItem

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-breadcrumb>
    <bk-breadcrumb-item to="/">Home</bk-breadcrumb-item>
    <bk-breadcrumb-item>Current Page</bk-breadcrumb-item>
  </bk-breadcrumb>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| extCls | String | - |  |
| separator | String | '/' |  |
| separatorClass | String | - |  |
| replace | Boolean | - |  |
| backRouter | oneOfType | - |  |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | BreadcrumbItem components |

| showValue | Boolean | true |  |

| extCls | String | '' |  |
| withValidate | Boolean | true |  |

- **Import**: `import { DatePicker } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/date-picker`
- **Category**: Navigation

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-date-picker v-model="date" type="date" placeholder="Select date" />
  <bk-date-picker v-model="dateRange" type="daterange" />
</template>
```

#### Props

| allowCrossDay | boolean | false |  |

### Menu

Navigation menu component supporting vertical and horizontal modes, sub-menus, groups, and collapse behavior.

- **Tag**: `<bk-menu>`
- **Import**: `import { Menu } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/menu`
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Sub-components**: Item, Submenu

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-menu :active-key="activeKey">
    <bk-menu-item key="home">Home</bk-menu-item>
    <bk-submenu key="settings" title="Settings">
      <bk-menu-item key="profile">Profile</bk-menu-item>
    </bk-submenu>
  </bk-menu>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| activeKey | String | - |  |
| collapse | Boolean | - |  |
| openedKeys | string[] | - |  |
| mode | MenuMode | 'vertical' |  |
| uniqueOpen | boolean | true |  |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| click | - |
| update:activeKey | - |
| update:openKeys | - |
| openChange | - |
| collapse | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | MenuItem and Submenu components |
| icon | - |
| title | - |

### Navigation

Application-level navigation component with sidebar and header layout, typically for backend admin pages.

- **Tag**: `<bk-navigation>`
- **Import**: `import { Navigation } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/navigation`
- **Category**: Navigation

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-navigation>
    <template #side-content>
      <bk-menu />
    </template>
    <template #default>
      Page content
    </template>
  </bk-navigation>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| navWidth | {
    type: [Number, String],
    default: 60,
  } | - |  |
| hoverWidth | {
    type: [Number, String],
    default: 260,
  } | - |  |
| showSideNavTitle | boolean | true |  |
| sideTitle | string | '' |  |
| headerTitle | string | '' |  |
| hoverLeaveDelay | number | 0 |  |
| hoverEnterDelay | number | 100 |  |
| defaultOpen | Boolean | - |  |
| headHeight | {
    type: [Number, String],
    default: 52,
  } | - |  |
| navigationType | BkNavigationType | 'left-right' |  |
| needMenu | boolean | true |  |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| leave | - |
| toggle | - |
| hover | - |
| toggle-click | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Main page content area |
| header | Header content |
| menu | - |
| footer | - |
| side-content | Sidebar navigation content |

### Steps

Step indicator for multi-step workflows. Shows the current step and progress through a sequence.

- **Tag**: `<bk-steps>`
- **Import**: `import { Steps } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/steps`
- **Category**: Navigation

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-steps :cur-step="currentStep" :steps="['Step 1', 'Step 2', 'Step 3']" />
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| theme | theme | - |  |
| size | size | - |  |
| curStep | Number | 1 |  |
| controllable | Boolean | false |  |
| direction | directionType | - |  |
| status | toType<`${StatusEnum}`>('status', {}).def(StatusEnum.UNKNOWN | - |  |
| lineType | lineStyleType | - |  |
| extCls | String | - |  |
| steps | Array | [] |  |
| beforeChange | Function | - |  |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| update:curStep | - |
| click | - |

#### Slots

No slots.

    </bk-form-item>
    <bk-form-item>

    </bk-form-item>

</template>

### Badge

Display a badge indicator (number or dot) on the top-right corner of another element. Commonly used for notification counts.

- **Tag**: `<bk-badge>`
- **Import**: `import { Badge } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/badge`
- **Category**: Data

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-badge :count="5" theme="danger">
    <bk-button>Messages</bk-button>
  </bk-badge>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| theme | String | 'primary' | badge theme |
| count | oneOfType | - | Number to show in badge |
| position | String | 'top-right' |  |
| radius | String | - |  |
| valLength | Number | 3 |  |
| overflowCount | Number | 99 | Show capped numeric value |
| dot | Boolean | false | Whether to show red dots with no content |
| visible | Boolean | false |  |
| extCls | String | - | 外部设置的 class name |

### Table

Data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column resizing, virtual scrolling, and custom cell rendering. Supports both column-config and slot-based column definitions.

- **Tag**: `<bk-table>`
- **Import**: `import { Table } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/table`
- **Category**: Data
- **Sub-components**: Column

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <!-- Column config mode -->
  <bk-table :data="tableData" :columns="columns" />
  
  <!-- Slot-based columns -->
  <bk-table :data="tableData">
    <bk-table-column label="Name" prop="name" />
    <bk-table-column label="Age" prop="age" sortable />
    <bk-table-column label="Actions">
      <template #default="{ row }">
        <bk-button text @click="handleEdit(row)">Edit</bk-button>
      </template>
    </bk-table-column>
  </bk-table>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | arrayOf | - | 渲染列表 |
| columns | arrayOf | - | Table 列渲染 |
| activeColumn | Number | -1 | 当前选中列 当设置选中多列时（columnPick = multi），配置为数组[index1, index2, index3]，只能选中单列时，可以为数值或者数组[index] |
| columnPick | toType<`${ColumnPickEnum}`>('columnPick', {}).def(ColumnPick | - | 表格列选中方式 支持：单列（single），多列（multi），禁用（disabled） 默认：disabled |
| height | StringNumberType('auto') | - | 设置表格高度 默认：auto 根据行数自动填充高度 100%，依赖初始化时父级容器高度 |
| stripe | Boolean | false | 是否为斑马纹 Table |
| minHeight | StringNumberType(LINE_HEIGHT) | - | 设置表格最小高度 默认：LINE_HEIGHT * 2 |
| maxHeight | StringNumberType('auto') | - | 设置表格最d大高度 默认：auto，依赖外层高度 |
| rowHeight | RowHeightFunctionNumberType | - | 行高，可以为固定数值类型 可以是函数，返回当前行的高度，返回值为数值类型 |
| headHeight | Number | LINE_HEIGHT | Thead行高，可以为固定数值类型 |
| showHead | Boolean | true | 是否显示Head |
| sortValFormat | arrayOf | - | 排序时对需要排序的字符串数值进行格式化 这里需要配置为正则或者回调函数，(str) => string \| number \| boolean 如果配置为正则，程序会提取匹配到的第一个结果尝试转换为数值 如果为多个，程序会顺序执行所有正则表达式，直到转换成功 |
| thead | toType<Thead>('ITheadType', {}).def({
    color: IHeadColor. | - | table header config |
| virtualEnabled | Boolean | false | 是否启用虚拟渲染 & 滚动 当数据量很大时，启用虚拟渲染可以解决压面卡顿问题 |
| border | oneOfType | - | 表格边框显示设置，可以是一个组合 生效规则: 除非单独设置 none,否则会追加每个设置 |
| pagination | Boolean | false | 分页配置 默认值为false，不启用分页 设置为 true，启用分页功能，默认值参考分页组件 Pagination |
| paginationHeight | Number | TB_FOOT_HEIGHT | 分页组件高度 在设置了分页配置之后才会生效 用于配置分页组件的高度，在不同项目中，分页组件高度会影响表格高度计算 这里设置为可配置项，避免自计算导致的性能问题以及不确定性样式问题 |
| remotePagination | Boolean | false | 是否启用远程分页 |
| acrossAll | Boolean | false | 是否支持跨页全选 |
| emptyText | String | - | emptyText: PropTypes.string.def('暂无数据'), |
| emptyCellText | oneOfType | - | 单元格数据为空展示 |
| isEmptyCell | oneOfType | - | 判定单元格是否为空 支持数组：判定条件为 arr.some(item => item === cellText) 支持函数回调：返回结果为 true \| false， ({ cellText, row, column }) => boolean |
| settings | ITableSettings | - | bk-table-setting-content |
| rowClass | oneOfType | - | 行的 class 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有行设置一样的 Style |
| rowStyle | oneOfType | - | 行的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有行设置一样的 Style |
| cellStyle | oneOfType | - | 单元格的 style 的回调方法，也可以使用一个固定的 Object 为所有单元格设置一样的 Style |
| cellClass | oneOfType | - | 单元格的 className 的回调方法，也可以使用字符串为所有单元格设置一个固定的 className |
| scrollLoading | oneOfType | - | 表格底部loading加载效果，可以配合表格scroll-bottom事件使用 详细配置可参考bk-loading组件 |
| reserveExpand | Boolean | false | 仅对 type=selection 的列有效，类型为 Boolean，为 true 则会在数据更新之后保留之前选中的展开收起操作（需指定 row-key） |
| selectionKey | String | '' | 仅对设置了selection的情况下生效 用于初始化或者更新row已选中状态 内部使用逻辑为：row[selectionKey]，可以为多级选择，但是多级选择只支持 row.child.child |
| checked | Array | [] | 默认选中行 仅对设置了selection的情况下生效 值可以为 [key1, key2, key3, ...] 或者 [row1, row2, row3, ...] 如果设置为key，则 selectionKey 必须设置，内部匹配逻辑为：row[selectionKey] === key |
| isSelectedFn | Function | undefined | 提供自定义判定当前行是否选中 如果设置了此属性，其他判定均不生效 ({ row }) => bool |
| rowKey | oneOfType | - | 行数据的 Key，用来优化 Table 的渲染 此key用于渲染table row的key，便于大数据渲染时的性能优化 在使用 reserve-selection, reserve-expand 功能的情况下，该属性是必填的。 类型为 String 时，支持多层访问：user.info.id，同时支持 user.info[0].id |
| showOverflowTooltip | IOverflowTooltipPropType | - | 当内容过长被隐藏时显示 tooltip, 此处为全局配置, 如果只配置此处，整个table都启用 column内部可以单个配置覆盖此配置 |
| asyncData | Boolean | false | 为避免不必要的数据修改导致的不可控组件更新 默认组件不会对传入组件的data进行任何修改 设置此属性为true则会对源数据进行同步（如：启用selection，勾选时想要自动同步到源数据） 目前只会对指定了selectionKey的情况下才会对指定的字段数据进行更新，同时需要指定 rowKey，保证匹配到的row是正确的目标对象 |
| rowHover | oneOf | - | 鼠标划过行样式行为 @param { ROW_HOVER.AUTO } @param { ROW_HOVER.HIGHLIGHT } |
| defaultSort | shape | - | 默认的排序列的 prop 和顺序。它的 prop 属性指定默认的排序的列，order指定默认排序的顺序 |
| isRowSelectEnable | Function | ( | 配合 column selection 使用 用于配置渲染行数据的勾选框是否可用 可以直接为 true\|false，全部启用或者禁用 如果是函数，则返回 true\|false ({ row, index, isCheckAll }) => boolean |
| resizerWay | toType<`${ResizerWay}`>('ResizerWay', {
    default: Resizer | - | 当外层容器尺寸改变时，当前组件用什么方式进行重新计算 默认为 throttle，按照指定频率重新计算 可选值：debounce，在指定时间范围内只执行一次重新计算 |
| observerResize | Boolean | true | 是否监表格尺寸变化而响应式重新计算渲染 |
| intersectionObserver | Boolean | false | 是否使用IntersectionObserver监听表格Cell进如有可视区域再渲染 |
| align | TableAlign | - | 对齐方式 |
| headerAlign | TableAlign | - |  |
| prependStyle | style | - | 插入至表格第一行之前的内容容器样式 默认样式为固定在第一行 需要跟随滚动或者其他样式，可以通过此配置进行覆盖 |
| colSortBehavior | toType<IColSortBehavior>('IColSortBehavior', { default: ICol | - | 列排序行为 independent：列与列之间的排序是独立的，互斥的 interdependent：列排序是相互影响、依赖的 |
| isFlex | Boolean | true | 是否采用flex布局表格 |
| rowDraggable | oneOfType | - | 是否支持行拖拽排序 |
| shiftMultiChecked | Boolean | false | 是否支持shift键多行选择 |
| scrollbar | Boolean | true | 启用Scrollbar |
| fixedBottom | toType<FixedBottomOption>('FixedBottomOption', {
    default | - | 固定在底部的配置项 |
| appendLastRow | toType<AppendLastRowOption>('AppendLastRowOption', {
    def | - | 表格尾部追加的行配置 |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | TableColumn components |
| empty | Content shown when data is empty |
| prepend | Content before the table |
| append | Content after the table |

### Tree

Tree view component for displaying hierarchical data. Supports expand/collapse, checkbox selection, drag-and-drop, filtering, and lazy loading.

- **Tag**: `<bk-tree>`
- **Import**: `import { Tree } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/tree`
- **Category**: Data

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-tree :data="treeData" :show-checkbox="true" @node-click="handleClick" />
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | arrayOf | - | 渲染列表 |
| label | Function | undefined | 指定节点标签为节点对象的某个属性值 |
| nodeKey | String | undefined | 每个树节点用来作为唯一标识的属性，此标识应该是唯一的 如果设置系统会默认自动生成唯一id |
| children | String | 'children' | 子节点 Key, 用于读取子节点 默认 children |
| indent | Number | 16 | 相邻级节点间的水平缩进，单位为像素 |
| lineHeight | Number | 32 | 设置行高 |
| height | Number | - | 设置树形组件高度 在设置 virtualRender=true时，请指定高度，避免组件自动计算高度导致多次渲染 |
| levelLine | Boolean | false | 设置层级连线 |
| virtualRender | Boolean | false | 是否开启虚拟滚动 默认虚拟滚动是开启的，数据量大的情况下有利于性能优化，可以通过设置 virtualRender = false 关闭虚拟滚动 |
| prefixIcon | Function | ( | 当前节点标识图标 默认 true |
| async | Function | undefined | 异步加载节点数据配置 @param callback 请求数据回调函数，函数返回 Promise @param cache 是否缓存请求结果，默认为True，只有在第一次才会发起请求，若设置为false则每次都会发起请求 |
| offsetLeft | Number | 5 | 每个节点偏移左侧距离 |
| search | Boolean | false | 搜索配置 可以为一个配置项 SearchOption 或者直接为一个字符串，如果直接为字符串则模糊匹配此值 |
| emptyText | String | '没有数据' |  |
| draggable | Boolean | false |  |
| disableDrag | Function | - |  |
| disableDrop | DisableDropHandler | - | 是否禁用拖拽释放操作 @param data @param type @param target @returns |
| dragThreshold | Number | 0.2 | 拖拽阈值 用于判断拖拽时鼠标位置与节点的距离 当鼠标位置与节点的距离大于此值时，才会触发拖拽 |
| dragSort | Boolean | false | 节点拖拽时可交换位置（开启拖拽可交换位置后将不支持改变层级） |
| dragSortMode | oneOf | - | 拖拽排序模式 - any: 允许拖拽到任意位置 - next: 只允许拖拽到同级节点的前后位置 默认 any |
| selectable | oneOfType | - | 节点是否可以选中 |
| disabledFolderSelectable | Boolean | false |  |
| showCheckbox | oneOfType | - | 是否支持多选 |
| disableCheck | Boolean | false | 是否禁用节点复选框 |
| checked | arrayOf | - | 默认选中的节点id，selectable为false时无效 |
| showNodeTypeIcon | Boolean | true | 是否显示节点类型Icon |
| selected | oneOfType | - | 默认选中的节点id，selectable为false时无效 |
| autoCheckChildren | oneOfType | - | 是否自动检查当前节点是否有子节点 节点前面的展开收起Icon会根据判定值做改变 如果需要自已控制，请设置为false |
| autoOpenParentNode | Boolean | true | 如果设置了某一个叶子节点状态为展开，是否自动展开所有父级节点 默认为true，如果设置为false，则每层状态需要自己控制 |
| expandAll | Boolean | false | 默认是否展开所有节点 |
| nodeContentAction | Function | ( | 节点内容点击行为 此处配置每个节点除了展开\收起箭头之外的内容块时的行为 默认为 ['selected', 'expand', 'click']，点击内容块为选中当前节点 可选值： - 'selected': 选中节点 - 'expand': 展开节点 - 'collapse': 收起节点 - 'click': 触发 nodeClick 事件 - 'checked': 切换复选框选中状态（需要 showCheckbox 为 true） |
| keepSlotData | Boolean | false | 是否作用域插槽抛出参数是否保持源数据的引用 如果设置为true，则作用域插槽参数格式为: { data: node, attributes: {} } 如果设置为false，则作用域插槽参数格式为: { ...node, ...attributes } attributes 为节点内置属性，包含节点是否展开，是否选中，是否有子节点等等 |
| checkStrictly | Boolean | true | 在显示复选框的情况下，是否严格的遵循父子互相关联的做法 |
| intersectionObserver | Boolean | false | 是否开启监听Tree节点进入Tree容器可视区域 |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| empty | - |
| nodeLoading | - |
| node | - |
| default | Custom node content |
| nodeAppend | - |

---

### VirtualRender

Virtual scrolling container for efficiently rendering large lists by only rendering visible items in the viewport.

- **Tag**: `<bk-virtual-render>`
- **Import**: `import { VirtualRender } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/virtual-render`
- **Category**: Data

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-virtual-render :list="largeList" :height="400" :item-height="36">
    <template #default="{ data }">
      <div>{{ data.name }}</div>
    </template>
  </bk-virtual-render>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onContentScroll | Function | - |  |
| list | Array | [] | 传入原始数据源 |
| enabled | Boolean | true | 是否启用此功能 如果设置为false，则此组件只会渲染两层指定的 容器，默认渲染两层 div 设置为true才会启用所有的虚拟渲染 & 滚动相关计算 此属性设置为了兼容需要按需开启\关闭虚拟渲染场景，避免外层设计两套样式架构 Note: 目前此属性不支持动态修改 |
| scrollEvent | Boolean | false | 是否启用内置的Scroll Listener 当启用虚拟滚动时（enabled = true），滚动监听为内置生效 只有当（enabled = false)时此配置项才生效 |
| lineHeight | oneOfType | - | 每行数据高度 默认为数值类型，默认高度 30px 如果每行高度不一致，可为回调函数：(index: number, row: any[]): number => {} 函数参数为当前行index & 当前行数据 row，row为数组，当不分组时，为当前行item 如果有分组展示， index 为当前分组 index， row为数组，当前行分组所有 item 数据 |
| minHeight | Number | 30 | 整体最小高度 |
| maxHeight | oneOfType | - | 整体最大高度 |
| height | String | '100%' | 整体高度 可设置具体值，如果设置为 100%，则组件会自动计算外层DOM元素offsetHeight，用于计算可渲染行数 |
| width | String | '100%' | 渲染区域宽度 如果设置 100% 则自适应外层元素宽度 |
| className | oneOfType | - | 最外层元素ClassName |
| contentClassName | oneOfType | - | 内层层元素ClassName |
| contentStyle | Object | {} | 内层元素样式 |
| scrollXName | String | resolveClassName('F-scroll-x' | 用于自定义X轴滚动条样式 |
| scrollYName | String | resolveClassName('F-scroll-y' | 用于自定义Y轴滚动条样式 |
| groupItemCount | Number | 1 | 分组展示，一行数据可能有多条数据 |
| preloadItemCount | Number | 1 | 预加载行数，避免空白渲染 |
| renderAs | String | 'div' | 外层Dom元素需要渲染成的目标元素 |
| scrollOffsetTop | Number | 0 | top 滚动填充 |
| scrollPosition | String | 'content' | 内置滚动位置 可选：container （最外层容器），content（内容层容器） Note: container 慎选，需要自己处理样式 & 位置 |
| abosuteHeight | String | 'auto' | 绝对高度 \| 实际高估 可选值： auto(根据行高和行数计算, LineHeight * List.length) number(外层给定高度，若为0，则不显示) |
| throttleDelay | Number | 60 | 滚动刷新计算间隔时间 默认60 ms |
| rowKey | String | undefined |  |
| keepAlive | Boolean | false | 数据改变时是否保持之前的状态 保持滚动条位置、当前渲染区间 |
| scrollbar | toType<IScrollbarOption>('IScrollbarOption', {
    default:  | - | 是否允许滚动条改变原有DOM结构 |
| autoReset | Boolean | true | 数据监听改变时，是否自动重置位置到[0, 0] |
| wrapperStyle | Any | {} |  |
| autoIndex | Boolean | true | 传入数据如果没有设置rowKey，是否自动生成$index作为唯一ID $index的值默认为index |

#### Events

No events.

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| beforeContent | - |
| default | Template for each rendered item, receives { data, index } as slot props |
| afterContent | - |
| afterSection | - |

</template>

| nextText | String | - | nextText: PropTypes.string.def('下一步'), |

| footerAlign | alignType | AlignEnum.RIGHT | 显示 footer 的位置 |

| dialogType | dialogTypeUnion() | - | 对话框类型 |
| isLoading | Boolean | false | 按钮loading |
| showContentClass | Boolean | true | 是否为默认内容区包裹 dialog-content 样式类 |
| transfer | oneOfType | - | 是否显示在body内即与#app同级 |

### Popover

General-purpose popover/tooltip component. Supports click, hover, and manual triggers. Based on @floating-ui for positioning.

- **Tag**: `<bk-popover>`
- **Import**: `import { Popover } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/popover`
- **Category**: Feedback

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-popover content="Popover content" trigger="hover">
    <bk-button>Hover me</bk-button>
  </bk-popover>
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| onAfterHidden | () => {} | - |  |
| onAfterShow | () => {} | - |  |
| isShow | Boolean | false |  |
| always | Boolean | false |  |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  |
| clickContentAutoHide | Boolean | false |  |
| width | oneOfType | - |  |
| height | oneOfType | - |  |
| maxWidth | oneOfType | - |  |
| maxHeight | oneOfType | - |  |
| content | toType<IContent>('IContent', {}).def('') | - |  |
| renderDirective | renderDirectiveType | 'if' |  |
| target | oneOfType | - |  |
| allowHtml | Boolean | false |  |
| placement | placementType | PlacementEnum.TOP_START | placement: placementType().def(PlacementEnum.TOP), |
| theme | String | 'dark' | 'dark', 'light' |
| trigger | triggerType | - | 触发方式 支持 click hover manual manual： 通过isShow控制显示、隐藏 |
| renderType | renderType | - | content 渲染方式 |
| arrow | Boolean | true | 是否显示箭头 |
| padding | Number | 5 |  |
| offset | oneOfType | - |  |
| boundary | String | 'parent' | 弹出内容绑定元素 |
| zIndex | Number | undefined |  |
| disableTeleport | Boolean | false |  |
| autoPlacement | Boolean | false | chooses the placement that has the most space available automatically |
| autoVisibility | Boolean | true | 当有滚动条，滚动出可是范围时自动隐藏pop |
| disableOutsideClick | Boolean | false | 是否禁用clickoutside |
| disableTransform | Boolean | false | 是否禁用样式的transform更新位移 |
| reference | Any | - | 自定义 reference |
| modifiers | Array | [] | 兼容v1版本遗留配置 不建议使用 |
| popoverDelay | oneOfType | - | popover显示和隐藏的延时时间 |
| extCls | String | '' | 配置自定义样式类名，传入的类会被加在组件最外层的 DOM |
| referenceCls | String | '' | 配置自定义样式类名，传入的类会被加在 Reference 外部的 div 上 |
| hideIgnoreReference | Boolean | false | 点击 Reference 占位区是否忽略收起 popover |
| componentEventDelay | Number | 0 | 自定义Content组件渲染，point-event延迟渲染时间 避免子组件point-event渲染时触发popover鼠标事件 如果设置为0，则不启用此设置 |
| forceClickoutside | Boolean | false | 或略其他判定条件，强制监听clickoutside & 执行hide |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| click | - |

#### Slots

| Slot Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Trigger element |
| arrow | - |
| content | Popover body content |

### Slider

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

---

### Transfer

Transfer (shuttle) component for moving items between two lists. Supports search filtering and custom rendering.

- **Tag**: `<bk-transfer>`
- **Import**: `import { Transfer } from 'bkui-vue'`
- **Package**: `@bkui-vue/transfer`
- **Category**: Feedback

#### Usage

```vue
<template>
  <bk-transfer
    :source-list="allItems"
    :target-list="selectedItems"
    :title="['Available', 'Selected']"
  />
</template>
```

#### Props

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | arrayOf | - | 顶部title(title[0]: 左侧title,title[1]: 右侧title,) |
| extCls | String | '' | 自定义class |
| searchPlaceholder | String | '' | 搜索框 placeholder |
| settingKey | String | 'id' | 唯一key值 |
| displayKey | String | 'value' | 循环list时，显示字段的key值(当list为普通数组时可不传传了也无效) |
| sortKey | String | 'value' | 排序所依据的key(当list为普通数组时可不传，默认按照index值排序) |
| searchable | Boolean | false | 是否开启搜索 |
| sortable | Boolean | false | 是否开启排序功能 |
| sourceList | arrayOf | - | 穿梭框数据源(支持普通数组) |
| targetList | arrayOf | - | 默认已选择的数据源 |
| emptyContent | arrayOf | - | 穿梭框无数据时提示文案 |
| multiple | Boolean | false | 支持checkbox多选模式 |

#### Events

| Event Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| change | - |
| update:targetList | - |

#### Slots

No slots.

---

## Directives

bkui-vue provides the following directives:

- `v-bk-clickoutside` — Detect clicks outside an element
- `v-bk-tooltips` — Attach tooltip to an element
- `v-bk-loading` — Show loading state on an element
- `v-bk-overflow-title` — Show tooltip when text overflows
